Hi Marta — thanks, and please pass on to Anders.

High level proposal (we can tune after PO):
- Bucket A (Q1 release): 2027-05-01 sweep (covers May–Jul usage).
- Bucket B (Q2 release): 2027-08-01 sweep (covers Aug–Oct usage).
- Bucket C (Q3 release): 2027-11-01 sweep (covers Nov–Jan usage).

Ledger mapping: each bucket becomes a dated prepay invoice line on Redwood's ledger. Spend consumption is reconciled daily and credited against the earliest open bucket; at month end we run a reconciliation and generate a usage offset invoice if consumption exceeds the bucket.

VAT evidence checklist (minimum):
- UK: VAT registration certificate + company registration number + valid billing address (PDF).
- DE: VAT certificate (USt-IdNr) and proof of business establishment (company extract).
- For other EU countries: local VAT certificate or OSS evidence for cross-border services.

Attachments: draft schedule CSV (sent inline), VAT checklist PDF.

Can you confirm you can provide the two certificates above and issue a PO referencing deal DL-4729? If yes, we’ll send the official invoice schedule and DocuSign SOW to sign.

Thanks,

Subject: RE: Prepay drawdown cadence — operational notes

Adding ops details for the record — forwarding Marta’s email below for context.

Operational constraints and confirmations:
- Sweep windows: funds must hit our clearing account by 17:00 UTC on the listed sweep date for the bucket to be considered "released". If funds clear after that time, bucket becomes effective on the next business-day sweep.
- Escrow: we support a tagged-escrow flow for committed spend. Redwood will keep funds segregated on our ledger and apply them in chronological order. We’ll provide quarterly statements.
- Reconciliation: we’ll run an automated recon job on the 5th calendar day after month-end; if consumption > bucket, we issue an offset invoice (net due 30). If consumption < bucket, the remainder rolls forward to the next bucket unless Nova requests refund at quarter close (refunds subject to finance approval).
- Accounting codes we need on the PO: GL-4800 (Prepaid AI credits), TAX-CODE-UK/D/EU. Please confirm the PO text with your AP.

For tax evidence we require PDFs only; a notarized copy is not necessary. If they prefer, we can accept links to a government registry instead of a certificate.

—Ben
Head, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
